newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse closes 0.07 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse closes 0.07 pct higher.

text.p: Tunis stock exchange on Monday closed higher by 0.07 percent in thin trade compared with the previous session, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 454.98 points, up from 454.66 points on Friday.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT won 0.92 dinar to 81.02 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.5 dinar to 32.5.
Chemical firm Alkimia rose 0.44 dinar to 40.46 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF advanced 0.29 dinar to 14.49. Detergents firm SPCD was up 0.2 dinar to 29.2 dinars.
UBCI bank was down 0.98 dinar to 41.02 dinars.
Household firm Ateliers Macaniques du Sahel eased 0.4 dinar to eight dinars.
BTEI bank declined 0.2 dinar to 21.8 dinars.
Total volume was 336,953 dinars against 828,046 dinars over the previous session.
